description: Who calls whom (VictoriaTraces dependency graph) and how each edge is doing (ClickHouse per-edge RED). ADR-059.

options.content:
This board answers one question: **who calls whom, and how is that call doing?**

- **Service map** comes from the VictoriaTraces dependency API (`/select/jaeger/api/dependencies`). It carries `callCount` only — that is the whole trade recorded in [ADR-059](https://github.com/duynhlab/homelab/blob/main/docs/proposals/adr/ADR-059-retire-tempo/README.md).
- **Per-edge RED** comes from the ClickHouse self-join below, which adds failure and p95 that the map cannot show.

The map is **not retroactive**: VictoriaTraces builds it from a background task on a 1-minute interval, so a freshly rebuilt cluster shows an empty graph until traffic flows. Query and caveats: `docs/observability/tracing/service-graph.md`.

panels.title: Service map — VictoriaTraces dependency graph
panels.description: Edges are derived by VictoriaTraces from stored spans. callCount only; for failure and latency per edge, use the table below.

panels.title: Per-edge RED — ClickHouse self-join (callCount, failed, p95)
panels.description: Parent/child span join over otel.otel_traces. `failed` counts a span status of Error at either end of the edge — see the doc for why it reads 0 on this platform today.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    caller.ServiceName                                                   AS client,
    callee.ServiceName                                                   AS server,
    count()                                                              AS callCount,
    countIf(caller.StatusCode = 'Error' OR callee.StatusCode = 'Error')  AS failed,
    round(quantile(0.95)(caller.Duration) / 1e6, 2)                      AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces AS caller
INNER JOIN otel.otel_traces AS callee
    ON  callee.TraceId      = caller.TraceId
    AND callee.ParentSpanId = caller.SpanId
WHERE caller.Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND caller.Timestamp <= $__toTime
  AND callee.Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND callee.Timestamp <= $__toTime
  AND caller.SpanKind = 'Client'
  AND callee.SpanKind = 'Server'
GROUP BY client, server
ORDER BY callCount DESC
